verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents Experiment APIs for managing flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools, which an agent could call. Flags support audience targeting by properties, cohorts, or segments, ramping, and turning off, and a published OpenAPI spec aids agent use. The MCP server is described only as bringing behavioral context and answers into AI tools, not as a way to manage flags. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for creating, targeting, and toggling flags; MCP-based flag management; agent-specific workflow docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
